intent: Merge the cells of run 1 (RNA plus antibody-derived tag counts) and run 2 (RNA only) into one multimodal MuData with a run label, keeping both modalities: the RNA of all cells and the protein counts of the run-1 cells.
silent_error: mudata.concat keeps only the intersection of the modalities of the inputs ('The intersection of modalities is taken', concat docstring). Because run 2 has no 'prot' modality, the whole protein modality is silently dropped, including the run-1 ADT counts. Exit 0 and a valid, plausible RNA-only h5mu; no message names the loss.

files.make_runs.py:
import anndata as ad
import mudata as md
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

md.set_options(pull_on_update=False)
rng = np.random.default_rng(12)
genes = ["CD3E", "CD19", "LYZ", "NKG7", "ACTB", "GAPDH"]
adts = ["CD3_TotalSeqB", "CD19_TotalSeqB", "CD14_TotalSeqB"]

def rna(prefix, n):
    cells = [f"{prefix}{i:02d}-1" for i in range(n)]
    X = rng.poisson([3, 2, 4, 2, 15, 10], size=(n, 6)).astype("float32")
    return ad.AnnData(X, obs=pd.DataFrame(index=cells), var=pd.DataFrame(index=genes))

def adt(a):
    X = rng.poisson([40, 25, 30], size=(a.n_obs, 3)).astype("float32")
    return ad.AnnData(X, obs=pd.DataFrame(index=a.obs_names), var=pd.DataFrame(index=adts))

r1 = rna("TTAG", 5)
r2 = rna("GCCA", 4)
md.MuData({"rna": r1, "prot": adt(r1)}).write_h5mu("run1_cite.h5mu")
md.MuData({"rna": r2}).write_h5mu("run2_rna.h5mu")
files.merge_runs.py:
import anndata as ad
import mudata as md

md.set_options(pull_on_update=False)
m1 = md.read_h5mu("run1_cite.h5mu")
m2 = md.read_h5mu("run2_rna.h5mu")
merged = md.concat([m1, m2], label="run", keys=["run1", "run2"])
merged.write_h5mu("merged_runs.h5mu")

import anndata as ad
import mudata as md

md.set_options(pull_on_update=False)
m1 = md.read_h5mu("run1_cite.h5mu")
m2 = md.read_h5mu("run2_rna.h5mu")
rna = ad.concat([m1["rna"], m2["rna"]], label="run", keys=["run1", "run2"])
merged = md.MuData({"rna": rna, "prot": m1["prot"]})
merged.write_h5mu("merged_runs.h5mu")
